name: B10-0108/2026 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision renewing the authorisation for the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified cotton T304-40 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to renew the licence for an imported genetically modified cotton, called T304-40. The cotton is engineered to survive spraying with weedkillers, including glufosinate, which is banned for use in the European Union. Parliament says the safety checks were incomplete, especially on long-term effects, and that Member States never backed the plan with a majority. This is an opinion; it does not itself change the law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the Commission to withdraw the renewal plan.
- **Who it affects:** Farmers, food and feed importers, and consumers in the European Union.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to drop the plan or keep it.
